owner_transaction_reports.notice: Recorded paper transaction report only. This is not broker execution evidence or a grant to redistribute raw market quotations.

usage_rules_review.scope: public website price display; API entitlement and noncommercial intent are not a verified redistribution grant

sources.finding: The owner requested disclosure of their own transaction prices. Publish recorded paper fills separately from raw quote fields, with simulation labels. A simple number and a copyrightable work are distinct; this distinction does not establish a broker/exchange contractual exemption or blanket quote redistribution permission.

The public securities API consent describes trading and data risks, but does not establish a blanket external-display permission. TWSE FAQ item 2 requires consent and a written contract for value-added market information supplied to others; no general noncommercial exemption was found.
The futures API consent describes non-display use of TAIFEX real-time ticks and clause 10 requires prior written consent or authorization for the specified redistribution and other uses.

The official MIS website supplies free viewing, but this does not extend the named Government Open Data daily grants to live ticks or order-book quotations. Existing internal acquisition is unchanged; no blanket public quote grant is established by browser visibility or noncommercial intent.

TWSE 11549 licenses daily OHLC, share volume, turnover and trade count, but does not list full-universe final Bid/Ask. TPEx 11370 additionally lists average, final Bid/Ask, next reference and next upper/lower bounds. Scope applies only to these named fields and daily datasets, not broker minute/tick quotations. Preserve attribution, market date, units and acquisition time; next-session bounds are not today's limits.

FinMind's July 2026 disclaimer states service access does not include external redistribution. Government-open-data records may follow the original open license; historical or delayed status alone is not a blanket permission. Public prices currently use independently verified canonical official files, not a relabeled FinMind quote.

The existing Free/VIP entitlement and data-download success do not establish raw-data external-display rights. The public acquisition page exposes sanitized quota, progress and catalog metadata, not raw FinLab tables. Keep this separate from the official-source price projection.

TEJ E-Shop terms restrict external disclosure of subscribed products. The local Smart Wizard product/account contract must be checked separately; do not assume an E-Shop clause is the user's complete Smart Wizard agreement. Publish acquisition metadata, not a raw vendor-data mirror.
